visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long hair, wearing a red baseball cap and a white long-sleeved shirt, stands on a concrete ledge by a green canal. She holds a fishing rod and looks towards the water. The background shows lush palm trees, white buildings, and a bridge under a bright, sunny blue sky. (2) The camera pans to show a group of people wearing yellow and pink shirts gathered by the canal's concrete wall. They are handling a large blue plastic bucket and a white styrofoam box near a metal railing. The ground is dry dirt with sparse patches of yellow-green grass. (3) Multiple shots capture individuals pouring dark, elongated eels from silver and blue buckets directly into the stagnant, algae-filled water of the canal. The eels are slippery and wriggle intensely as they fall. The water creates small ripples and splashes upon their entry. (4) A close-up shot focuses on a single dark eel swimming through the murky green water. The water surface is covered with green algae, fallen leaves, and some floating debris. The eel's body snakes through the thick liquid, moving away from the camera. (5) The scene abruptly cuts to an indoor restaurant setting. A pair of hands wearing a yellow sleeve places a steaming white plate of fried eel noodles on a light-colored wood-grained table. The dish consists of thin yellow noodles, dark eel slices, and stir-fried vegetables like onions and mung bean sprouts. (6) The woman from the beginning, still wearing her red cap and white shirt, is seated in the restaurant. She picks up a piece of eel with her chopsticks, eats it, and then puts her hands together in a prayer pose. She looks into the lens with a calm, satisfied expression. (7) A colorful graphic outro appears featuring a circular wreath of autumn leaves and flowers. The woman is seen in the center of the wreath, smiling and making a pointing gesture. Social media icons for YouTube and Instagram are displayed alongside slogan text at the bottom.
